verdict.rationale: Linear's docs publish exact per-auth-type API rate limits, response headers (e.g. X-RateLimit-Requests-Limit) and a leaky-bucket refill model, and separately allow admins to set spend limits for AI agent/automation usage that reset periodically — together these give a user real visibility into automation/API limits. However, the pack doesn't explicitly spell out the concrete consequence of exceeding a limit (e.g. exact 429 throttling behavior, whether overages incur extra charges, or a hard stop for automation/Loops usage), so the full 'what happens when I exceed' picture is only partially documented. Missing for 10: explicit statement of throttling/error response code, confirmation of no/optional overage billing, and documented consequence for exceeding automation (Loops/agent) usage specifically rather than just spend caps.
